fluff.overview: Most Clan infantry are solahma warriors at the end of their careers or who have failed their Trials, assigned to duties the warrior caste considers beneath notice. Foot Points are the most basic infantry formation, deployed on foot without transport. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they are best suited to garrison duty, facility security, and defensive positions where their lack of mobility is less of a liability. Equipped with Mauser 960 laser systems, a respected Inner Sphere-manufactured weapon that provides solid energy weapon capability at a fraction of the cost of Clan-produced equivalents.
